_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Virtual Shelf Commonality Report
summary: The Virtual Shelf Commonality Report identifies commonality information that the government uses in managing Total Ownership Cost (TOC).
use_relationship:
The Virtual Shelf Commonality Report identifies commonality information that the government uses in managing Total Ownership Cost (TOC).
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data product resulting from the work task described by the contract.
The Virtual-Shelf can be accessed from the following website: https://www.pdrep.csd.disa.mil/default.htm and may be used for guidance.
This DID supersedes DI-MGMT-81971.

distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and the dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Virtual Shelf Commonality Report shall be in the Contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Report shall identify by Ship Work Breakdown Structure (SWBS) the following information:

children.title: Which parts and specifications from the Virtual Shelf have been applied.
What percentage of system components, by SWBS, have been applied.
All parts that have been rolled over from a previous ship design.
Which rolled over parts of previous design are included in the Virtual Shelf.

preparation_instructions.title: The Report shall identify by SWBS and systems,
preparation_instructions.content: how many deviations from the Virtual Shelf parts and specifications are being requested.

preparation_instructions.title: The technical and business case analyses for
preparation_instructions.content: the deviation request specified in the Virtual Shelf shall be included in the report.
